description: Checks a transport quote request sent to Kras-Trans: status, the price from dispatch (net, with validity date) and, after the price is accepted, where to print the pre-filled CMR consignment note. Needs the quote number (e.g. KT-12, from request_transport_quote or the e-mail) and the e-mail address used in the request. Never accept the price for the user: give them the client panel link, they accept it there with one click.

email.description: E-mail address used in the quote request

name: get_quote_status
title: Check a Kras-Trans quote: status, price and CMR
